data.description:
#The Real Florida Adventure

##Duration

Approx. 11 Hours

## About This Tour

You’ve come all the way to Florida, so it makes sense to actually see as much of it as possible, and no other tour provides such a wide-ranging, in-depth experience as our carefully crafted Real Florida Adventure.

This action-packed day an overview of what’s in store as we head out to the beautiful Crystal River area on the Gulf coast, 80 miles north-west of Orlando. This is the Manatee Capital of the World, and the only place in America where it is legal to swim with manatees.

It is also home to stunning natural springs and lots of wildlife, and you’ll get to meet an essential part of it as we gear up for the signature Manatee Snorkel under the supervision of a Coast Guard Certified Captain *. You will learn all about the unique West Indian manatee – and then get to see some of them, up close and personal in the crystal-clear waters!

Then we head off to 210-acre Homosassa Springs State Park, a genuine hidden gem of Florida nature, where there is plentiful local wildlife to see and hear about, including the endangered Florida panther, black bears, red wolves, bobcats and alligators, as well as a profusion of birdlife, notably whooping cranes and flamingos.

Also here is the unique sight of Nature’s Fish Bowl, an underwater observatory built over the mouth of the main spring where a huge number of fish hang out, while the Park has its own manatee rehabilitation program to provide another exciting glimpse of these rare sea mammals. Lunch is included, here, too.

Finally, the day will conclude with an exciting airboat ride on the Withlacoochee River, another natural haven where you can see more wildlife in its natural habitat and enjoy the thrill of skimming the water at up to 45mph in these exhilarating, flat-bottomed craft.

* NB: any person wishing to do the manatee swim must hire a wetsuit prior to boat departure. Wetsuit rental is handled when you arrive at the manatee boat tour.  Snorkel equipment is provided free. Flotation devices are available for your use.  Life vests are available if needed.

**Inclusions**
* Boat tour of Kings Bay and Crystal River
* Complimentary Mask and Snorkel 
* Packed Lunch provided by Publix: 6 inch ultimate sub on white bread, tavern ham, OvenGold turkey breast, top round roast beef, and Provolone cheese, lettuce and tomato, bag of chips, 2 cookies, 1 drink. **Vegetarian, Vegan and Gluten free can be accommodated with min 48hours notice**
* Admission into Ellie Schiller Homosassa Springs Wildlife State Park
* A wild airboat ride on the Withlacoochee River
* Roundtrip Transportation from International Drive, Disney and Kissimmee areas
* Professional, Certified and Licensed Tour Guide

**Not Included**
* Mandatory $15 wet-suit rental fee for any swimmers
* Gratuities 

###What to bring
Sunscreen, Sunglasses, Camera’s, Swimsuits, Towels, Insect Repellent, Proof of Confirmation

#**Gratuities**
Your tour guides gratuities are NOT included in the cost of your tour package.  Although, not compulsory, tipping is expected and is an expression of your satisfaction with the people who have assisted you throughout your tour.  Although it may not be customary to you, it is of considerable significance to the tour guide who will take care of you for the entire day.  As a guide for you, based upon the cost of the tour booked:
**10% - $14 | 15% - $21 | 20% - $28  (suggested gratuities are per person)**

###Wetsuit Rental, Life Vests & Floats
$15 Wetsuit rental is handled when you arrive at the manatee boat tour. Snorkel equipment is provided free. Flotation devices are available for your use. Life vests are available if needed.

###Lunch

**Lunch includes:** 6 inch  sub sandwich (White bread, ham, turkey, American cheese), bag of chips, cookies and a bottle of water.

We will attempt to accommodate special dietary requirements when given a **minimum of 48 hours** notice, **HOWEVER** due to the type of food offered we may not be able to accommodate every type of request.  Should we be unable to fulfill a request, we would suggest bringing your own food for the days activities.

###What to bring
We suggest wearing swimsuit underneath your clothes to ensure speedy boarding on to manatee boats.  Sunscreen, Sunglasses, Camera’s, Swimsuits, Towels, Insect Repellent, Proof of Confirmation, and optional gratuities for guides.  **PLEASE BRING CLOTHES TO CHANGE OUT OF YOUR SWIMWEAR, YOU CANNOT BOARD THE TOUR VEHICLE WITH WET CLOTHES.**

##Weather:
Florida climate is characterized as tropical with rainfall predominantly occurring between May and October. Thunderstorms are usually in the afternoon and come and go fairly quickly. The rain usually lasts for about 30 minutes or so and in Florida it can literally be raining on one side of the street and sunny on the other. Due to this unpredictability, all tours operate RAIN OR SHINE unless SEVERE weather is forecast. A forecast of questionable weather does not negate our cancellation or refund policies and timelines.
